title: Delta detection: canonical-JSON hashing and computeDelta
description: Pure module. canonicaliseJson (recursive key sort, no whitespace), hashDocument (sha256:<hex> over the canonical form of a parsed document), computeTreeHash (over sorted (id, docHash) pairs), and computeDelta (returns the proposal 2026-09-22 section 2.2 shape: frozen, frozenAt, treeHash, currentTreeHash, changed, added, removed, briefSince, unchanged). Ledger docHashes are added under ledger:<name> ids per sidecar the caller passes.
